name: Zha Jichi Daozhi Aiqing Huozai
source:
The main character is Aris, a young aristocrat who has been relegated to the lower layer, which gives him a strong desire to return to the upper layer.

After he says goodbye to Bryant, his boss, he meets Deacon, his best friend for years and a prisoner on death row. They are suddenly attacked by a resurrected corpse. When Aris wakes up, the resurrected corpse Caeran actually becomes his co-worker.

[From [url=https://mokamwww.itch.io/fried-chicken-wings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角是阿里斯，一位被贬到下层的年轻贵族，这让他有强烈的愿望回到上层。

在与他的老板布莱恩特告别后，他遇到了迪肯，他多年来最好的朋友，也是一名死囚。他们突然遭到复活尸体的袭击。当阿里斯醒来时，复活的尸体凯兰实际上成为了他的同事。

[来自[url=https://mokamwww.itch.io/fried-chicken-wings]itch.io[/url]]
